solution.description: FPIP (Finance & Procurement Intelligence Platform) core schema — 13 tables, 6 security roles.

securityRoles.name: FPIP Procurement
securityRoles.permissions: read/write Requisition, Tender, Bid, PurchaseOrder, RfqSchema, RfqResponse; read Supplier, Contract

securityRoles.name: FPIP Finance
securityRoles.permissions: read/write Invoice; read PurchaseOrder, Contract, Supplier

securityRoles.name: FPIP Auditor
securityRoles.permissions: read-only on all fpip_* tables, no write

securityRoles.name: FPIP Supplier Portal User
securityRoles.permissions: read published RfqSchema; create/read/write only own Bid, Invoice, ComplianceDocument, RfqResponse (referenced Supplier = own); no visibility into other suppliers

securityRoles.name: FPIP Agent Service
securityRoles.permissions: read-only on all fpip_* tables; no create/write/delete/assign/share
